answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because raven only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, saffron is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any ripple approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
